what: og:image / twitter:image on three live sites pointed at a screenshot of the Lovable preview sandbox, hosted on a third-party R2 bucket

measured_before_touching.scan: every apps/*/index.html (excluding node_modules, dist, _archive) grepped for r2.dev | lovable.app | lovable.dev
measured_before_touching.note: all three carry BOTH og:image and twitter:image, all on the same bucket host pub-bb2e103a32db4e198524a2e9ed8f35b4.r2.dev

production_before.method: GET of the live page, meta tags parsed out of the served HTML (saved as before-production-*.html)

the_assets_are_live_and_foreign.so_not_a_broken_image: all three resolve today; the defect is ownership and provenance, not a 404
the_assets_are_live_and_foreign.why_that_matters: the filename is the builder's own screenshot of id-preview-*.lovable.app. It is a picture of the PREVIEW SANDBOX, not of production, taken months before every copy and icon change made since. Nothing we deploy can refresh it and nothing we deploy can keep it alive.

not_claimed.image_contents: what the three screenshots actually depict was NOT verified. The connection here is Netfree-filtered: downloading the galil one returned 69866 bytes against a declared Content-Length of 453140, and the bytes decode to Netfree's placeholder ('כעת התמונה נשלחה לנטפרי לבדיקה'), not to the site. current-og-image.png in this folder is that placeholder, kept as the evidence of the substitution.
not_claimed.consequence: the finding rests only on facts that survive the filter: the host, the filename, the timestamp, the HTTP status. No claim is made about how the card looks.

fix.galil: og:image + twitter:image -> https://more30.com/galil/pwa-512.png (self-hosted, the icon the PWA already installs); twitter:card summary_large_image -> summary, because the asset is square and not 1.91:1
fix.mthbram: og:image + twitter:image -> https://more30.com/mthbram/icon-512.png (self-hosted, the icon manifest.json already declares); twitter:card -> summary
fix.egod: the three tags REMOVED, not repointed. egod has no image of its own: public/ holds favicon.ico and placeholder.svg only, and that favicon.ico is byte-identical (SHA256 DD821076A9B03ADC...) across 15-egod, 21-mthbram, 22-get-your-rights and 24-galilee-connect-hub — it is the builder's default. Pointing at it would swap one generator signature for another. Recorded in NEEDS_USER.

verified_on_the_build_not_the_source.method: npm run build in all three apps, then the emitted dist/index.html parsed
verified_on_the_build_not_the_source.why_a_grep_is_admissible_here: the earlier rule (a missing Hebrew string in dist is not evidence, because esbuild escapes some of it to \uXXXX) does not apply: these are ASCII URLs in static HTML, not strings inside a JS bundle. The first count run was 1-per-app and that was the new HTML COMMENT, which contains the literal 'r2.dev'; re-counted on the bucket host itself and it is 0.

a_thing_measured_on_the_way.identical_favicon: favicon.ico is the same file, same SHA256, in 15-egod, 21-mthbram, 22-get-your-rights and 24-galilee-connect-hub. 16-chatzor-connect and 12-smel-ndln have none. This is a §6 signature on the browser tab and it is not fixed here.
a_thing_measured_on_the_way.manifest_paths_checked_and_fine: mthbram's index.html writes href="/manifest.json" and "/icon-192.png" root-absolute, which looked like the /bkalot base-href trap. Production serves them rewritten to /mthbram/... — Vite applies base to index.html hrefs at build. No defect.

not_deployed.reason: the Vercel free-per-day window is exhausted (core.issues #83); it drops under the ceiling around 11/08 00:11Z
not_deployed.staging_left_alone: _deploy/egod-more30/egod holds a build that PREDATES this change. It was not overwritten. Whoever gets the next slot must rebuild egod and re-copy, and must diff against the live HTML first (deploy-copy-can-break-live-sites).
